L819: ### Why Start with a Single Course?
L820: 
L821: Try before you commit: Experience WGU’s online, self-paced learning model before you enroll in a full degree program.
L822: 
L823: Explore degree paths: Select a course that aligns with your goals to get a feel for your desired program or career path.
L824: 
L825: Earn credit that counts: The credits you earn from your course can apply toward a WGU degree.
L826: 
L827: Learn on your schedule: With no set class times, you can complete your course at a pace that works for you.
L828: 
L829: COST
L830: 
L831: Starting at $25
L832: Most courses cost $25 each, allowing you to jump-start your higher education journey at a low cost.
L833: 
L834: TIME
L835: 
L836: Flexible by Design
L837: 
L838: Single courses take 2–3 months to complete with self-paced online learning that works around your schedule.*
L839: 
L840: RESULTS
L841: 
L842: A Proven Path
L843: 
L844: Over 10,000 students have started a WGU degree program after finishing their course or course bundle.
L845: *If you need more time to complete your course, you can continue working through it with a $99 monthly subscription until you finish. Please note that the PACA + IT & Tech Fundamentals course bundle subscription is $199 per month.
L846:

L865: ### Basic Skills for Educators
L866: 
L867: Cost: $25
L868: Term Length: 2 months
L869: Do you aspire to be a teacher? To effectively pursue that goal, it is critical that you attain basic skills in reading, writing, and mathematics. In this course, you will engage with these subjects and gain knowledge that helps prepare you to become an effective educator. You will explore mathematical concepts, analytical reading, and writing guidelines.
L870: Along the way, you will encounter the same types of questions, problems, and passages that appear on standard exams required for teacher licensure in many states. Get ready to learn—and take an essential step toward becoming an educator.
L871: 【230†View Syllabus†academyproduct.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com】
L872: ### Learners and Learning Science (Bachelors)
L873: 
L874: Cost: $25
L875: Term Length: 2 months
L876: Level: Bachelor's Degree Students Only
L877: How do students learn? This is a key question you will explore in this course. You will consider concepts related to learning environments and educational levels, from early childhood through adolescence. As you study the material, you will encounter evidence-based practices and the practical application of learning science principles. These can help equip your students with strategies to enhance learning outcomes and increase engagement.
L878: After completing this course, you will be an empowered educator—ready to create effective, inclusive, and engaging learning experiences for your students.
L879: 【231†View Syllabus†academyproduct.s3.us-east-2.amazonaws.com】
L880: ### Organizational Behavior
L881: 
L882: Cost: $25
L883: Term Length: 2 months
L884: 
L885: Have you ever noticed how organizations have different cultures? Some may exhibit positive morale and collaboration. Others may experience challenges in team building and productivity. The success of organizations can often be traced back to how people act within them. In this course, you will learn about those behaviors and how they affect group achievement. This knowledge will be an asset in any professional role.

L1103: Course Bundles
L1104: 
L1105: When you enroll, you'll have the option to take one of our curated course bundles. Each bundle includes two thoughtfully paired courses that help you explore your chosen area of interest.
L1106: 
L1107:     COURSE BENEFITS
L1108: ## Your First Step Toward a WGU Degree
L1109: 
L1110: Taking a single course is a low-cost, low-commitment way to experience WGU, earn credit, and make progress toward a degree before committing to a full degree program.
L1111: 
L1112: 【260†Image】
L1113: 
L1114: ### Start with Less Pressure
L1115: 
L1116: Whether you’re exploring WGU for the first time or returning to a goal you paused, a WGU course gives you a clear, manageable place to begin or pick back up.
L1117: 
L1118: 【261†Image】
L1119: ### Learn What Works for You
L1120: 
L1121: Use your course to explore an area of study, develop an online learning routine, and discover what kind of support helps you stay on track.
L1122: 
L1123: 【262†Image】
L1124: 
L1125: ### Move Forward with Confidence
L1126: 
L1127: When you finish, you’ll have more than a completed course. You’ll have momentum, experience, and a clearer sense of how to continue toward your degree.
L1128: 
L1129: 【263†Image】
L1130: ### Your Completed Course Can Apply Toward a Degree
L1131: 
L1132: Credits from WGU courses may apply toward select WGU degree programs. Continue your education with a head start whenever you’re ready.
L1133: 
L1134: ### Frequently Asked Questions
L1135: ### Cost & Payment Options
L1136: 
L1137: How much does a single course cost?
L1138: 
L1139: Most WGU courses cost $25 each while course bundles (consisting of two courses) cost $49 each. That includes course access and e-textbooks—no hidden fees.
L1140: 
L1141: Is financial aid available for these courses?
L1142: 
L1143: Federal financial aid is not available for these courses. We offer our courses at a heavily discounted rate to give you a low-cost start option.
L1144: 
L1145: What if I need more time to finish?
L1146: Your single course includes access for an initial term (term length varies by course). If you need more time after the initial term, your enrollment transitions to a $99 monthly subscription that you can cancel anytime.
L1147: ### Getting Started
L1148: 
L1149: What happens after I enroll?
L1150: 
L1151: After enrolling, you’ll receive an email to set up your student portal. After you log in, you’ll complete a short orientation. Once you complete orientation, you can access the course.
L1152: 
L1153: When can I start?
L1154: 
L1155: Enrollment for WGU courses is open year-round. After you complete the enrollment process, you can start your course right away.
L1156: 
L1157: How long does it take to finish a course?
L1158: It depends. The courses are self-paced and competency-based, meaning you can move as quickly as you master the material. Each course has an initial term length (ranging from two to three months), and most students complete their course within that term with regular studying.
L1159: ### Coursework
L1160: 
L1161: How do WGU courses work?
L1162: 
L1163: WGU courses are online and self-paced, giving you the flexibility to complete coursework when it fits your schedule. With WGU’s competency-based model, you move forward as soon as you master the material—rather than progressing based on class time. With a consistent weekly study routine, most students complete their courses in just a few months.
L1164: 
L1165: What learning support is available?
L1166: Each course includes access to Tutor.com, which offers 24/7 tutoring services, and Grammarly for writing assignments. Course Instructors and Student Experience Specialists will support you with assessments, course content questions, and goal setting.
L1167: 
L1168: What are the assessments like?
L1169: Assessments measure your mastery of skills and knowledge. You may complete objective assessments (quizzes or proctored multiple-choice exams) and performance assessments (written or project-based work evaluated by expert graders). Most courses allow exam retakes as part of your learning journey. To pass a course, you must earn a grade equivalent to a C or better.
L1170: ### Accreditation & Credits
L1171: 
L1172: Is WGU accredited?
L1173: 
L1174: Yes, WGU and its certificate programs are institutionally accredited by the Northwest Commission on Colleges and Universities (NWCCU).
L1175: 
L1176: Will my course credits transfer?
L1177: 
L1178: Your completed course will appear on your official WGU transcript. If you plan to transfer course credit to another institution, that school will review your transcript and determine transfer equivalency.
L1179: 
L1180: Can WGU course credits count toward a WGU degree?
L1181: Yes. Many WGU courses are stackable, meaning the course credit you earn may apply toward a related WGU degree program. Eligibility varies by course and degree, so review program details or speak with an Enrollment Counselor to explore your options.
L1182: 
L1183: Your Next Step Starts Here
L1184: 
L1185: Enroll in a WGU course today. No admission to a full degree program is required.
L1186:
